linux_primitive.checked_facts: renameat2 RENAME_NOREPLACE refuses an existing destination; filesystem flag support is required. EXDEV refuses movement across mount points. EINVAL can indicate unsupported flags. Ordinary rename can replace a destination and is not a safe fallback.
linux_primitive.implementation: ctypes libc renameat2 with directory FDs and flag 1; explicit ENOSYS/EINVAL/EOPNOTSUPP refusal; no fallback to overwrite or shutil.move.
linux_primitive.local_command:
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=src python3 - <<'PY'
import ctypes, platform
print({'system': platform.system(), 'kernel': platform.release(), 'libc': platform.libc_ver(), 'renameat2': hasattr(ctypes.CDLL(None), 'renameat2')})
PY
linux_primitive.evidence_level: Actual temporary-file explicit-scope deletion/archive positives exercised the syscall, not a mocked successful rename. No claim that every filesystem or machine supports it.

contract.public: run_gc(..., *, cfg=None, lake=None). Explicit cfg mapping required; cfg=None returns blocked. Product CLI and periodic/emergency callers pass actual cfg; controller callers also pass their Lake.
contract.lower: gc_checkpoints/gc_results/archive_to_cold_storage(..., *, scope=None). Missing or mismatched GCScope raises GCRefused before writes. The scope factory is gc_scope(results_dir, cfg, *, lake=None, lake_db_path=None, checkpoints_dir=None, archive_dir=None).
contract.authority: Roots, declared sources, control and actual catalog protected. Matching existing result task directory required. Keep hints cannot authorize deletion. Fresh closed authority and captured identity checked under existing task effect guard; no DB bootstrap or lifecycle mutation.
contract.io: Metadata-only bounded no-follow snapshots precede the guard. Same-root quarantine intent, no-replace detach and parent fsync occur under the guard. No large tree walk/hash/delete or archive movement is held inside it. Captured quarantined identities govern reclamation.
contract.uncertainty: Possibly completed detach retains effect owner. Reclamation failure retains quarantine and reports errors; subsequent GC detects pending quarantine even without a source candidate. No automatic replay/recovery.
contract.accounting: Actual success counted only after completed quarantine receipt. Dry-run count keys are previews and create no markers/guards. Delete freed_bytes remains logical file size, not physical blocks. Same-filesystem archive uses moved_bytes and freed_bytes=0. Measured free_gb is an un-attributed disk snapshot.
